title: Design System: Artificia AI, The Build Notebook

display.purpose: Home heading; wide uppercase, second clause lime.

headline.purpose: Section headings; emphasis is a lime underline.

label.purpose: Metadata under titles; never above a heading.

motion.name: stroke-draw
motion.purpose: Drawings and rules write themselves in once.

components.name: Input
components.description: Mat field on the Binding plate.

components.name: Door
components.description: Hero chooser row between ink rules.

narrative.overview: Charcoal graph paper on an 18px ruling, a dim lime margin rule, black binding bars, and a single lime pen that draws, ticks and underlines. Flat, ruled and annotated rather than carded; wide heavy uppercase Roboto Flex headings over plain reading text; notebook entries with metadata under the title.
keyCharacteristics: One charcoal ramp plus ink; lime is the only chroma.
Wide uppercase display type, 2px corners, ruled lists instead of cards.
Lime single-stroke drawings that take the form of the question they answer.
Motion is drawing, run once, absent under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Lime marks; it never fills surfaces, backs panels or colours body text.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Any grey is a ramp step.

rules.name: The Warn Rule
rules.body: Warn appears only on invalid fields and form status errors.

rules.name: The Under Rule
rules.body: Entry and metadata lines sit under their title, never above; no eyebrow or kicker above any heading.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is made with rules and ink, not shadows.

dos: Do put the real logo image top-left on Binding; use Roboto Flex throughout.
Do use lime only as marker.
Do make every grey a ramp step.
Do draw a diagram in the form of the question it answers.
Do put entry and metadata lines under titles.
Do keep videos and the map behind a click.
Do keep the stats caveat with any stats.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above any heading.
Don't use a radius above 2px, boxed shadowed cards, hard offset shadows, glyph icons or another display face.
Don't use lime for body text or panel fills.
Don't use Warn outside form errors.
